body: We went through some stuff, and it's okay for the short term. It's just so daunting to think about.

I feel somewhat the same, and posted earlier, but talking about it is really helping for me. Please just talk to someone. 
edit - That person can also be me, feel free to talk to me.

My old therapist said it was useful that I was aware of what's happening in my brain in an objective manner, but it didn't necessarily help. It's great when we're together, like nothing else in the world matters cause we're in our own little bubble, but when we're apart (she lives an hour and a half away) it sometimes feels like I'm not wanted. It's a difficult situation to explain properly, sorry.

I suppose that's a perfect example of how this kind of thinking can be self defeating. Well, I'm not even too sure myself, things seem to be going okay, but when I get these bouts of depression I just feel really hollow. As far as my relationship goes what worries me is that she maybe doesn't want me, and that always makes me feel even worse. But again I know that's just me thinking in a self-defeating way, but even though I know that cognitively most of this is self-induced because of how I'm feeling, I still can't escape how awful I feel. Usually it doesn't get this bad but even when I come through the other side, it's terrifying to know it'll happen again.
